claim: SSRF protection defaults to OFF; --enable-ssrf-protection must be explicitly set to true, and only then does --inference-pool (or INFERENCE_POOL env var) become mandatory.

TLS to the prefill, decode, and encoder hops is configured via --enable-tls/--tls-insecure-skip-verify/--tls-min-version/--tls-cipher-suites, a per-stage flag design fully independent of Kubernetes -- these are plain Go crypto/tls settings.
stance_target: concern that the P/D sidecar has no transport-security option outside Kubernetes
quoted_support: fs.StringSliceVar(&opts.enableTLS, enableTLS, opts.enableTLS, "stages to enable TLS for. Supported: prefill, decode, encode...")
